# OrbytLink

> OrbytLink connects AI agents to MCP servers and APIs through one gateway. Teams can preserve repeatable work as reusable skills and workflows.

Contact: hello@orbytlink.com
Product: https://app.orbytlink.com/
Last updated: 2026-11-07

## What OrbytLink is

OrbytLink is a gateway for AI agents. A team connects each app once (an MCP server, or any API with a key or OAuth sign-in), and every agent they use, such as Claude, Cursor or any MCP client, reaches all of those apps through a single endpoint. The agent sees only the tools it needs, and credentials stay in OrbytLink instead of in each agent.

## What it does

- **One connection point.** Add apps from a catalog of ready-made MCP servers and APIs, or add your own. Agents use one MCP endpoint and one token per agent.
- **Teams and access.** Workspaces can be shared with an organization, with admin and member roles and invite links, so people share connections without sharing secrets.
- **Skills.** A shared library of agent skills (written instructions for a task) that agents can find and load when they are relevant. Skills can be private, shared with a team, or public.
- **Workflows.** When an agent finishes a task well, OrbytLink can capture it as a workflow: a fixed, ordered list of tool calls that runs the same way every time, on a schedule or on demand, without a model in the loop. A workflow can include decision steps, retries, saved state, cached results and a step-by-step run log. Workflows export to and import from a plain Markdown file.
- **AI models.** Teams can call text models through OrbytLink and pay for what they use from prepaid credit.
